data.title: $100 a Week Into Bitcoin Since Its $126,000 Record High: What Would It Be Worth Now?
data.description: Bitcoin's historic hack sent prices tumbling nearly 40% from their peak, and one unlucky investor who started buying at the all-time high now faces a critical question: how long can dollar-cost averaging keep their portfolio from collapse?
